> Business Description:
Maestro is a collective of pianists performing together on stage, creating immersive and interactive live music experiences. Blending classical, contemporary, and improvisational elements, Maestro brings together artists from diverse backgrounds to push the boundaries of live performance.

> Key Pages:

- Home: https://www.maestroconcerts.com/
- Album: https://www.maestroconcerts.com/album
- Artists: https://www.maestroconcerts.com/artists
- Collaborations: https://www.maestroconcerts.com/collaborations
- Concerts: https://www.maestroconcerts.com/concerts

> Concept:
Maestro is a collaborative musical experience where multiple pianists share the stage. Performances combine structured pieces, improvisation, and audience interaction, creating a unique and ever-evolving show.

> Artists:
The collective is composed primarily of pianists, occasionally joined by other musicians and vocalists, creating a rich and evolving musical identity.

> Future Vision:
Maestro aims to expand its performances with more instruments, larger stage setups, recorded projects, and live tours across France and beyond.

> Tone:
Artistic, collaborative, and immersive.
